speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Does the Minister of State agree that residents may feel anxious and unfairly treated if insurance claims are denied due to technicalities, especially in cases where hospital bills arrive late, causing delays in submission?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Furthermore, does the Minister of State acknowledge that policyholders are often at a disadvantage in negotiating with insurers as the illness becomes a pre-existing condition once diagnosed, limiting their ability to switch to a more accommodating provider?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: And can institutions step in to assist residents in appealing to insurers?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Additionally, can MOH, as the regulator and key player in the healthcare system, play a more active role in helping patients negotiate with insurance companies in such situations?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: The first point on the issue of any difficulties arising from billing delays, I can acknowledge and appreciate that that would be of concern to residents or patients.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: This is something that does get surfaced every once in a while.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: The point is, it really depends on the facts.
